versions.content: Shall provide the ability to define naming conventions for pub- lic symbols 37 of 57  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 536: AUTOSAR_RS_StandardizationTemplate Requirements on Standardization Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Type: valid Description: The standardization template shall provide the ability to define naming conventions for public symbols. This especially includes requirement ids, module abbreviations, meta data and configuration symbols used in the document of a release Rationale: Avoid ambiguities and name clashes inside the specification. Provide a consistent uniform presentation of meta data to the reader of the specification. Allow automatic processing of specification elements.
